lines.text:
Oooh, wow. So you beat Lt. Surge?
You must be pretty good!\c
Glad to see you’re really learning a thing or two.
And your Pokémon must’ve tried their best!
Misty healed your Pokémon for you!
Misty healed your Pokémon for you!

MISTY: Oh, me?
I’m going swimming in the sea.\c
There are times when you just want to break free
from a puny little pool and swim in the big blue!

Where are you headed next?\c
Have you been to Diglett’s Cave?
It’s pretty close by.\c
If you haven’t been, I could show you the way.
Want a guide?
Oh? Well, that’s some way to turn down such\na nice offer.
MISTY: This is Diglett’s Cave!\c\nDiglett dug out this cave path all on their own!\nOK, see ya! Be sure to meet lots of Pokémon!
